sports.body: India secured their eighth Women's Asia Cup title after defeating Sri Lanka by 72 runs. The Indian team declined to accept the trophy from Asian Cricket Council president Mohsin Naqvi. This decision followed a similar stance taken by the men's team after a previous tournament. BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia cited ongoing military conflict and national sentiment for the refusal.
